name: Restart sampling (segments, any sampler, flow-aware)
plain: Restart sampling that wraps any non-SDE sampler. You give segments as [n, k, t_min, t_max]: at the schedule sigma nearest t_min, jump back up to t_max k times and walk down again in n steps using a chosen restart scheduler (Karras, exponential, normal, simple, ddim_uniform, sgm_uniform). 'default' means [3,2,0.06,0.30],[3,1,0.30,0.59], and 'a1111' copies the WebUI rule (no restarts below 20 steps). t values can also be timesteps (negative numbers) or percentages. RestartScheduler outputs the expanded list with the upward jumps, and RestartSampler finds each jump and adds noise there, so the two can be used separately. For flow models the jump scales the latent as well as adding noise, so the noise level is correct. The noise is torch.randn_like on the global RNG unless a custom noise function is supplied.
math:
Symbols: σ_a lower, σ_b higher at a jump; z ~ N(0,I).
EDM jump: x ← x + √(σ_b² − σ_a²)·z.
Flow jump: c = (1−σ_b)/(1−σ_a); x ← c·x + √max(σ_b² − (c·σ_a)², 0)·z.
Plan: for each segment at σ_k ≈ t_min: normal steps to σ_k, then k × [jump to t_max, restart_scheduler(n) from t_max down to σ_k].

props.extra_model_calls: n per restart repeat, times k, per segment
props.params: segments='default', restart_scheduler, scheduler, steps, denoise, chunked_mode=True
